name: Aethermint Phase Bloom
description: A crystalline mint residue harvested from phased distillations.
specialEffects: Used in phase draughts, cooling tinctures, and shimmer-brew recipes.

steps: Refine raw stock for Aethermint Phase Bloom under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Aethermint Refinery protocol before storage.
